# Independent benchmark evidence

This directory is separate from the internal regression registry in
`validation/manifest.json`. Internal fixtures detect changes in openWFN. External
benchmarks compare openWFN with independently executed software and documented
reference procedures.

A case is `active` only after all of the following are recorded and reviewed:

- the exact input path and SHA-256 checksum;
- input origin, generation information, upstream commit, and redistribution status;
- reference program, exact version, and extraction procedure;
- expected values, units, conventions, and explicit tolerances;
- a passing comparison generated by `scripts/run_external_benchmarks.py`.

Successfully running an input does not make a case active. Missing software,
unknown provenance, unavailable inputs, or incomplete reference evidence keep a case
`pending`. Pending cases are visible in reports and are never counted as passes.

External fixtures are supplied with `--input-root` when redistribution has not been
approved. Do not commit third-party binaries, restricted calculation files, private
filesystem paths, credentials, or license material.
